title: ETABS workflows and connector status

Computers and Structures

ETABS

ETABS focuses on analysis and design of multistorey building systems.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Model a building frame

Use the idealised geometry, material assumptions and analysis scope. In the intended ETABS preview, model a building frame; the visible result is a solver-ready model view with mesh regions and constraints exposed. Review units, connectivity, mesh suitability and model assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Apply lateral load cases

Start from the selected load cases, contacts and solution controls. In the intended ETABS preview, apply lateral load cases; the visible result is a configured analysis state with loads and boundary conditions visible. Review load paths, restraints, convergence controls and applicable codes before accepting or exporting it.

Review storey response and design

Begin with the completed result set and acceptance quantities. In the intended ETABS preview, review storey response and design; the visible result is plots or tables that connect response values to the model. Review convergence, sensitivity, units and engineering reasonableness before accepting or exporting it.
